Meetings are open to the public with time for community comment. Agendas post to the City site as a courtesy and legal notice goes up at the venue 72 hours ahead, so confirm the agenda before you go. See the schedule below for upcoming meeting dates.
vendors.address: 2911 Sports Arena Boulevard, Suite A, San Diego, CA 92110
